as_told.title: Diana Pasulka on second-century Latin written on rockets

plain: Old Latin, from the second century, is said to have been written on some space missions, on the rockets themselves. Jesse Michels repeats this twice as something said by Diana Pasulka, a professor who studies religion and UFO belief; once he places it on the rocket's fairing, the shell that covers the nose of the rocket. If true, it would hint at old religious or esoteric ideas tucked inside modern spaceflight.
